review_evidence: README identifies Ix as a zero-knowledge proof-carrying-code platform with its own Lean kernel/typechecker and compiler, not merely an application wrapper.
Complete scan of 598 Lean files found proposition declarations in 311 files (3,394 theorem/lemma/axiom/example lines), including extensive Ix/Tc/Verify soundness and preservation developments.
Representative verification modules prove normalization, inference, definitional-equality, ingress and block-admission invariants; these are substantive formal-methods prior art.
summary: Reviewed Ix as a proof-carrying-code/typechecker verification development; retain the complete unit.
